rulings.barItem: a refusal without a cause the story shows, or the same cause drawn twice; a run of refusals
rulings.reason: Step 1's refusal is caused by 'the nonempty key Aya mistyped', but Aya has no key to mistype until step 2 creates it (fal keys are generated in the dashboard UI: https://fal.ai/docs/api-reference/platform-apis/authentication.md, 'generate a key from the UI'). The cause the step names presupposes a credential the story makes afterwards, so the 401 has no cause the story shows.
rulings.correction: Move the key creation (step 2) before the refused check (step 1): Aya creates her key, mistypes it into Editor's credential check and is refused with authorization_error, then saves it correctly and step 3 validates it. Keep the steps' requests and expectations otherwise unchanged.

rulings.barItem: vendor behaviour the vendor's documentation contradicts
rulings.reason: Steps 5, 8 and 11 send resolution '720p', num_images 1 and output_format 'jpeg' to fal-ai/ideogram/v2 and expect 200 (5, 8) with images.0.content_type 'image/png'. The model page https://fal.ai/models/fal-ai/ideogram/v2/api (and the pack's spec IdeogramV2Input) documents exactly prompt, aspect_ratio, expand_prompt, seed, style, sync_mode and negative_prompt: Ideogram v2 offers no resolution, image count or output format. The life presents Scheduler choosing a 720p JPEG that the endpoint cannot select, and its own png expectation contradicts the output_format it sends.
rulings.correction: Remove resolution, num_images and output_format from the bodies of steps 5, 8 and 11, leaving prompt, aspect_ratio and expand_prompt (the documented inputs the Scheduler sets); keep the png and download expectations.

rulings.barItem: vendor behaviour the vendor's documentation contradicts
rulings.reason: Step 3 asserts prices.0.unit equals 'image' for fal-ai/flux/dev. The model's own page https://fal.ai/models/fal-ai/flux/dev states 'Your request will cost $0.025 per megapixel. Images are billed by rounding up to the nearest megapixel.' The pricing reference's sample (https://fal.ai/docs/platform-apis/v1/models/pricing.md) is illustrative, and this pack's own vendor-examples.json records prices.0.unit as undecided ('the sample is not a general contract for that value'). The life pins a billing unit the vendor's page for that endpoint contradicts.
rulings.correction: Replace the prices.0.unit equality in step 3 with an exists check (keep the endpoint_id and has_more expectations).
